description.zh: 西路军由靖远虎豹口渡河西进，经古浪、永昌、山丹进至临泽、高台。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: The West Route Army crossed at Hubaokou in Jingyuan and moved west through Gulang, Yongchang, and Shandan to Linze and Gaotai. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.

name.zh: 高台—倪家营子—梨园口—石窝

description.zh: 高台失守后，西路军经倪家营子、三道柳沟、梨园口转入祁连山，在石窝山分兵游击。路线为示意，待按行军日志细化。
description.en: After the fall of Gaotai, the West Route Army moved through Nijia Yingzi, Sandaoliugou, and Liyuankou into the Qilian Mountains and dispersed at Shiwo Mountain. The route is schematic and awaits refinement from march logs.
